In Switzerland, the universal emergency number to call in any urgent situation — including when a helicopter rescue is needed — is:

**144**

This number connects you to the **Swiss emergency medical services (Rega)** as well as other rescue coordination centers. Rega operates the helicopter rescue service throughout Switzerland and will deploy a helicopter if it can reach the victim faster or is otherwise more appropriate than ground-based ambulances or other rescue services.

So, even though a helicopter might be the fastest option, you should still call **144** to alert the Swiss emergency services and ensure coordinated rescue efforts.
